这边林熙看着手机，心情十分的激动，韩雪峰能来直播，这绝对是个大事，带来的流量可太大了。

期末考试之后，正是七月中旬，盛夏时节，阳光灿烂，到处都是盛开的花，金色的阳光落在五颜六色的花瓣上，有一种如梦似幻的美丽。

就连巴以冲突，中东问题，大规模杀伤性武器，伊朗核问题，伊拉克局势，甚至伊拉克大选，和英国脱欧这种类型的话题，都拿到达沃斯去讨论，并且还得到解决。

听到这个声音楚天逸一下就愣住了，这个声音给了他一种奇怪的感觉，似乎和记忆中的一个声音，产生了某种特殊的契合。虽然声音不大，但是却如同重锤一般的砸在了他的心弦之上。

这不，刚刚稳住身形之后，他又再次冲了出去，他就是不信自己的炼月刀会无法从正面击败赵曜，刀与棍之间，如果不是都是武魂，棍早就输了。

请假了估计是有事呗，正常人在这个世界上，谁还没点事呢，再说了苏楠的请假频率，并不算很高。

史莱克不费吹灰之力，于三天后再次打败敌手，进入八强。按照积分来算，他们全盘完胜，自然轮不到他们去跟那支轮空的队伍争夺八强之位。

最后，她是被急救车紧急送到校医院的，那天她正讲着课，忽然的天旋地转，等到人反映过来的时候，身体已经不听使唤的软在地上，教室里的学生发出一阵尖叫，有人立刻打了120，有人去教室办公室通知其他的老师。

走出浴室的时候，秦朗却不知什么时候进了她的卧室，甚至半躺在她的床上，“你怎么在这里？”叶离脱口问出。

张不笑满脸狰狞的说到，只不过他这算是自爆了吗？这样的事情难道不都应该属于阴谋算计一类的吗？这个缺心眼的家伙怎么会这么明目张胆的说出来呢？

时间不知过去了多久，天色渐渐昏暗下来，天要黑了，他们还处在三不管地带。

不过一会儿浴室里传来了哗哗的水声，可怜了大少爷，刚洗完热水澡现在又要洗冷水澡。

Lin Xi looked at her phone here, feeling very excited. It was definitely a big event for Han Xuefeng to come to the live broadcast, and the traffic it brought was huge.

After the final exam, it was mid-July, the midsummer season, the sun was shining brightly, and flowers were blooming everywhere. The golden sunlight fell on the colorful petals, giving it a dreamlike beauty.

Even topics such as the Palestinian-Israeli conflict, the Middle East issue, weapons of mass destruction, the Iranian nuclear issue, the situation in Iraq, and even the Iraqi election and Brexit were all discussed in Davos and were resolved.

Chu Tianyi was stunned when he heard this voice. This voice gave him a strange feeling, and it seemed to have some special fit with a voice in his memory.Although the sound was not loud, it hit his heartstrings like a heavy hammer.

No, after just stabilizing his body, he rushed out again. He just didn't believe that his Moon Refining Sword could not defeat Zhao Yao from the front. If the sword and the stick were not both martial souls, the stick would have lost long ago.

He probably asked for leave because he had something to do. A normal person in this world would have nothing to do. Besides, Su Nan's frequency of asking for leave was not very high.

Shrek effortlessly defeated his opponent again three days later and entered the quarterfinals.In terms of points, they had a complete victory, so naturally it was not their turn to compete with the team that had a bye for the top eight.

In the end, she was rushed to the school hospital by an ambulance. She was giving a lecture that day when she suddenly started to spin. When people realized what she was doing, her body was already limp on the ground. The students in the classroom screamed. Someone immediately called 120, and someone went to the classroom office to notify other teachers.

When walking out of the bathroom, Qin Lang entered her bedroom at some point and even half-lyed on her bed. "Why are you here?" Ye Li blurted out.

Zhang Buxiao said with a ferocious face, but was he self-destructing?Shouldn't such things fall into the category of conspiracy and calculation?How could this heartless guy say it so blatantly?

I don't know how long time passed. The sky gradually became dark and it was getting dark. They were still in the no-care zone.

But after a while, there was a sound of rushing water in the bathroom. Poor young master, he had just taken a hot bath and now he had to take a cold bath.
